suitableFor: digital-catalog / vehicle-type category tile grids on a light section
icon + title + short description tiles where the whole tile is a link
3-up navigation tile rows with no explicit button
notSuitableFor: brand/logo tiles with an explicit Visit Site CTA button (use cards-brand)
editorial article grids with photos and read-more links (use cards-article)
blue product-category tiles with a See Products CTA (use cards-category)
